ValidationRule.description: Opportunity cannot go to Closed Won from Lead Generation or Lead Qualification or Opportunity Development or Negotiation
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType.DeveloperName = "TTS_OTCRM_Opportunity" && ISCHANGED(StageName) && ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won") && ( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName),"Lead Generation") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName),"Lead Qualification") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName),"Opportunity Development") || ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName),"Negotiation") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Opportunity cannot go to Closed Won from Lead Generation or Lead Qualification or Opportunity Development or Negotiation
